enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Turns off alarm on phone. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to wardrobe. Opens wardrobe door. Selects shirt. Selects trousers. Closes wardrobe door. Removes pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on trousers. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Checks phone for messages. Walks to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Turns on tap. Adjusts water temperature. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Lathers hands. Washes face. Rinses face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits in sink. Rinses toothbrush. Places toothbrush in holder. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Hangs towel. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out cereal box. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl. Takes out spoon. Closes cupboard. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Puts milk back in refrigerator. Eats cereal with spoon. Drinks remaining milk from bowl. Places bowl and spoon in sink. Washes hands.

Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Checks phone for bus schedule. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Steps onto bus. Taps card on reader. Walks to seat. Sits down. Puts backpack on lap. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks to office building. Opens door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs at nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Enters password. Opens email client. Reads new emails. Responds to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Attends team meeting. Takes notes. Discusses program logistics. Returns to desk. Makes phone calls to community partners. Schedules events. Updates database. Prints flyers. Organizes files.

Walks to cafe. Opens door. Orders sandwich. Pays cashier. Waits for food. Receives sandwich. Finds table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Checks phone. Throws away trash. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs at nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Reviews program plan. Edits document. Sends emails to stakeholders. Makes phone calls. Attends video conference. Takes notes. Prints reports. Files documents. Organizes supplies. Updates social media.

Walks to bus stop. Checks phone. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Steps onto bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks to house. Unlocks door. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner and eating it with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Greets Member 2. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Places on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot. Fills pot with water. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Adds vegetables to pot. Stirs pot. Sets table. Calls Member 2 to eat. Sits down. Eats dinner. Talks to Member 2. Asks 'How was your day?'

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching television with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Turns to Member 2. Says 'What do you want to watch?' Leans back. Puts feet on coffee table. Continues watching TV.

Watches TV. Presses channel button. Watches news. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Returns to living room. Sits down. Drinks. Watches TV. Changes channel. Watches movie.

Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens browser. Checks email. Browses social media. Watches video. Types on keyboard. Moves mouse. Clicks links. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp.
Walks to living room. Turns on light. Picks up book. Sits on sofa. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Continues reading. Adjusts sitting position. Reads more pages. Closes book. Puts book down.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Turns on tap. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Puts on pajamas. Hangs towel. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.
Lies in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Sleeps.
